title: Kirby Problem 3.50
exact_target: Is every integral homology sphere that is an L-space the three-sphere or a connected sum of arbitrarily oriented Poincaré spheres?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2848 (KP-3.50). CC BY 4.0.
